QuestInfo.name: Robin the Walking Encyclopedia
QuestInfo.0: #bRobin#k, who mutters excitedly to himself as he stands at Snail Hunting Ground 1, knows a lot about job advancement. Perhaps you should speak with him.
QuestInfo.1: Robin promises to teach you everything you could ever want to know about stats, AP, and job advancement. But you have to take a quiz afterwards. He seems awfully fixated on that quiz... Guess you should talk to him and study up before continuing with the quest 'Robin the Walking Encyclopedia.'
QuestInfo.2: You passed Robin's quiz! He looked a little wistful as you walked away, as if he wanted to give you another one...

0.0: A new traveler! You should have some #bAP#k by now. Did you #bdistribute it#k? No? Then, allow me to teach you a thing or two. I'll give you a #bquiz#k at the end to make sure you understand stats, AP, and job advancement. Oh, I do so love any excuse for a quiz!

yes.0: Click on me again and ask me all your questions! Once you're confident you have all the answers, click on the #bRobin the Walking Encyclopedia#k quest to start the quiz! Hehehe, quizzes make me sooo happy!

no.0: Aha! You think you already know everything, eh? If so, then I dare you to take my quiz. Do it! Make my day!

1.0: Ready for the quiz? Yippee! First question! When you level up, you get #bAbility Points, or AP for short#k. You use AP to raise your #bSTR, INT, DEX, and LUK#k stats. As a #rBeginner#k, is it possible to raise your #bHP and MP#k with AP?  \r\n#b#L0# Yes, it's possible starting at level 11. #l\r\n#L1# No, it's not possible ever. #l
1.1:
You've got the answer! Next question! Although you start as a beginner, you can eventually make a job advancement after you have reached a certain level. #bYou can normally make a job advancement when you have reached Level 10#k, but #bwith this particular job, you can make a job advancement at Level 8.#k. What is this job? 
#L0##b Warrior #l
#L1# Magician #l
#L2# Bowman #l
#L3# Thief#l
#k
1.2:
Ding, ding, ding! Yes! Only Magicians can undergo job advancement at Level 8. Laaaaaast question! Here's a list of jobs and the locations where you undergo job advancement. #bWhich of these do not match?#k
#b#L0# Warrior  -  Perion #l
#L1# Magician  -  Ellinia #l 
#b#L2# Bowman  -  Henesys 
#b#L3# Thief  -  Nautilus
1.3: Yesssss! #bThieves must go to Kerning City!#k Only #bPirates go to the Nautilus for their job advancement#k! Bravo! Now you'll have no trouble picking a job when the time comes. Thank you for humoring me. This quiz totally made my day!

yes.0: Plan ahead and think about what job you'd like. When you make your job advancement, your AP will be redistributed to fit your new job. So you don't need to worry about your AP just yet.

1.0: That is incorrect. You can make a job advancement at Level 10 for most of the jobs. Only Magicians can make job advancements at Level 8. Please try again from the beginning.

1.4: WRONG!! Only Magicians can make their job advancement at Level 8, because users that have raised INT to become a Magician have a rougher time leveling up at first. RESTART!
